title: The car wreck with Thomas and Sam
summary: The interviewer recalls an untaped story about a wreck; Paul says Sam got out of the car with Thomas and they could not see the oncoming car.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You were talking about that wreck that they had. Thomas started to tell me about it. We never got it on tape.
Never got it on tape. Well what happened that Sam was on the outside of the car. He got out with Thomas. And they couldn't see that car coming. So when the fellas seemed as if they had saw us.
